packages.name: Vintage Christmas Carols
packages.description: Sixteen historic Christmas carols and songs from 1898 to 1922, performed by choirs, quartets, and orchestras. Public-domain remote MP3 audio from the Internet Archive.
packages.author: Internet Archive

packages.name: Christmas Carols from the National Jukebox
packages.description: Fifteen historic Christmas carols, songs, and instrumental selections from the Library of Congress National Jukebox, recorded between 1911 and 1917. Public-domain remote MP3 audio from Archive.org digitizations of Victor and Edison recordings.
packages.author: Library of Congress / Archive.org

packages.name: Classic Christmas Carols Instrumental
packages.description: Nineteen instrumental arrangements of Christmas carols and seasonal selections from 1912 to 1922, performed by early 20th-century orchestras, bands, theatre organs, and instrumental ensembles. Public-domain remote MP3 audio from Archive.org.
packages.author: Archive.org

packages.name: Advent Scripture and Carols
packages.description: A journey through the four weeks of Advent, mixing public-domain King James Version scripture readings with public-domain carols. Readings from LibriVox Advent lectionary and KJV Bible; carols from LibriVox Christmas collections and vintage 78 rpm recordings.
packages.author: LibriVox / Archive.org

packages.name: Christmas Gospel Songs
packages.description: Public-domain spirituals and carols that tell the Christmas gospel story, including the African-American spiritual "Rise Up, Shepherd an' Foller." Features LibriVox CC0 recordings and early-20th-century 78 rpm recordings from Archive.org.
packages.author: LibriVox / Archive.org
